title: Get digital card information

# Get digital card information

Get information about a digital card with the API, including its status and the card it belongs to.

:::tip Webhooks
Subscribe to the `DigitalCard.Created` and `DigitalCard.Updated` webhooks to know when a digital card is created or changes status. Learn more about [tracking digital card changes](./index.mdx#tracking-status).
:::

## Guide {#guide}

1. Call the `digitalCard` query.
1. Enter your digital card ID (line 2). If you're resolving a webhook event, use the event's `resourceId`.
1. Add the information you need. Include both fragments to get the status at every stage: `PendingDigitalCard` returns `ConsentPending`, `Pending`, or `Declined` (line 8), and `CompleteDigitalCard` returns `Enabled`, `Suspended`, or `Canceled` (line 14).

## Query {#query}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {2,8,14} showLineNumbers
query getDigitalCard {
  digitalCard(digitalCardId: "$YOUR_DIGITAL_CARD_ID") {
    id
    type
    cardId
    ... on PendingDigitalCard {
      statusInfo {
        status
      }
    }
  }
}
```
